name: workbridge-commander
description: Operate authorized workstations through WorkBridge Commander and a WorkBridge-qualified Desktop Commander payload.

interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT and Codex to the WorkBridge Commander remote MCP service, which routes authenticated requests to WorkBridge-qualified Desktop Commander payloads on explicitly selected workstations.
capabilities: Inspect and edit authorized workstation files
Run and interact with workstation processes
Route work to an explicitly selected connected workstation
Preserve WorkBridge effect disposition and connection-generation safety
defaultPrompt: Use WorkBridge Commander to inspect the connected workstation and continue the active work.
Run the requested command through WorkBridge Commander and verify the observed result.
Use the smallest authorized workstation effect and verify mutations by readback.
